subject: Hobgoblin Captain
picture: All-ages fantasy coloring book page, portrait, bold black outlines, large simple shapes. A hobgoblin captain stands in a cave war room and pins a dagger into a simple tunnel map on a wooden table. He looks like a soldier, not a goblin: broader jaw, flat nose, short pointed ears close to the head, no tusks, no long elf ears, medium athletic build, upright commanding posture, large armor plates. The map is only a few wide tunnel paths, no words, no letters, no tiny dashes. The cave has a stone ceiling, simple rock walls, a weapon rack with a few large swords, and two closed wooden doors with plain boards and almost no wood grain. The floor is a few large stone slabs, not a mosaic of small tiles. A couple of simple crates sit in the corners. The drawing reaches all four edges. Every region is a big closed shape to color.

line_rules.ink: bold pure black outlines on white
line_rules.shapes: large closed regions a child or adult can color quickly
